measured vapour pressures and the critical point
source.fit: 28 measured values (27 from the ThermoML Archive) and the critical point, 273.11-660.00 K, max deviation 1.9 %. Between 412.11 K and the critical point the curve is held only by the critical point. All the measured sets fitted together, each article with the same weight (no set preferred for a smaller stated uncertainty), pooled because they agree: each set lies within its mean stated uncertainty of the curve on average; mean deviation of the fit from each set: Negadi 2014 +0.14 %. The largest deviations are at values whose stated uncertainty exceeds 10 % (1 values, 11-11 %); among the values stated within 10 %, the largest deviation is 1.9 %.

references: Nikitin 2023 (critical point, an article outside the archive)
